newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gensec plans to issue preference shares.
newsitem.headline: Gensec plans to issue preference shares.

text.p: South African trading and underwriting group Genbel Securities Ltd said on Thursday that it aims to increase its financing capacity by creating 50 million redeemable cumulative preference shares.
A Gensec spokesman said the level of premium the shares would be issued at had not yet been decided upon.
The firm said the move was in order to style itself more like a United States investment bank where such share structures are more common.

"In certain circumstances preference shares can be an effective funding route in terms of cost. By creating these shares Gensec is giving itself additional flexibility and expects to issue some of these shares shortly," Gensec chief executive Anton Botha said in a statement.
